text: Based on Earth-observation data, the largest tree-cover loss event on this property occurred in **2020**—before the baseline for your claim. The event covered **67.7 hectares**, far exceeding any other losses recorded (e.g., 25.5 ha in 2015). No losses of 0.5 ha or larger were detected within your claim period (2021–2025). Changes after 2020 were minor (e.g., 0.4 ha in 2021) and below the detectable threshold. The analysis used high-resolution global forest datasets (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020), ensuring robust detection of significant events.
